subject: Control tour availability — compact ops window proposal
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearfinance.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@auditsuite.io>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Request: short control tour + DPA clarifications

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team wants a focused control tour (SOC 2 scope plus DPA touchpoints) before we pull procurement trigger. Prefer a 60–75 minute window with ops and product present — we want to see the realtime audit logs, how keys are managed, and the incident response playbook flow.

High level asks:
- 60–75 minute walkthrough (screenshare + Q&A)
- A brief set of sample evidence links beforehand if possible
- Confirmation about pen-test process (in-house vs vendor, timeline)

We are roughly available the week of Dec 6 and prefer morning CET (08:30–11:30 CET). Clara here will participate as our external auditor and may push a couple of technical questions.

Can you propose 2 or 3 slots? Also let us know who from Redwood will be on the call — product, ops, and security ideally.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Security, ClearFinance
security@clearfinance.com

---

Attachment: none (will accept early evidence via Drive link)

Samir —

Appreciate the clear list. We can run a compact 75-minute session that covers SOC 2 control mapping, a live demo of the audit logs + evidence export, and a short Q&A with our infra on key management and incident response.

Proposed slots (CET):
1) Mon Dec 6, 09:00–10:15 CET
2) Tue Dec 7, 08:30–09:45 CET
3) Wed Dec 8, 10:00–11:15 CET

Attendees from Redwood: Lauren Bishop (Head of Security Programs) — will lead the control mapping; Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer) — will demo logs and evidence exports; myself for product/contract questions.

Pre-call materials I can share now: a 2-page SOC2-quick-summary and a short DPA exceptions spreadsheet showing items commonly discussed. I will upload to a shared Drive unless you prefer DocSend.

Do any of those slots work? If you prefer evening CET, we can open a late slot on Dec 7 (17:00 CET) but that would be outside our usual ops window.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Director, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s) referenced: SOC2-quick-summary.pdf, DPA-exceptions.xlsx

Thanks Markus. Quick operational notes from our side:

- Ben will prepare a short runbook and a canned logs export to show during the demo (we'll avoid any customer identifiers in the live export).
- Ops bridge: we'll include an ops-bridge ICS invite (ops-bridge-invite.ics) and a minimal checklist for the call owner.
- Pen-test scope: we typically engage an external vendor for high-assurance engagements; for procurement purposes we can outline the vendor cadence and a rough timeline (2–4 weeks prep, testing windows vary). If ClearFinance has a preferred vendor, we can coordinate.

If Samir confirms a slot, Ben and I will do a 30-minute prep the day before to validate the demo script.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference

Samir — happy to confirm final logistics. The Drive folder is shared here: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-SOC2-evidence (contains SOC2-quick-summary.pdf and DPA-exceptions.xlsx).

Call details: Tue Dec 7, 08:30–09:45 CET (calendar invite sent; ops bridge details in the invite). We'll use the bridge for any sensitive Q&A.

Notes before the call:
- Ben will run the logs export demo; it's a sanitized sample.
- Lauren will start with a 10-minute control mapping to SOC 2 categories, then the demo, then 20 minutes for detailed questions with Clara/your security team.
- For pen-tests: yes, we support scoped vendor tests under an NDA. Typical outline: statement of work (1 week), prep/whitelist (1–2 weeks), testing window (1 week), report + remediation (2–4 weeks). If you prefer your vendor, we can share our vendor checklist and coordinate an MoU.

If anything changes ping me directly. Looking forward.

– Ben Carter
